device_info.description: One compute device's identity and coarse capability — what the registry/coordinator reads to enumerate devices and pick one for a piece of work. Kept deliberately coarse (presence + rough capacity); per-operator support is reported by each op's return status, not duplicated here. Mirrors zetta::compute::DeviceInfo in include/zetta/compute/compute_device.hpp.

compute_units.description: CPU logical cores or GPU streaming multiprocessors.

kind.description: The hardware family the device drives. Append-only enum (the lowercase name is the stored identifier); 'cpu' is reported on every machine, 'cuda' only where a CUDA backend is present.

memory_bytes.description: Total device memory in bytes. 0 means host / unknown (a CPU device's host RAM is not separately budgeted).

unified_memory.description: Whether the device shares the host address space (a CPU device, or an integrated GPU). Optional; absent means false.

description: The coordinator-facing report a node's DeviceRegistry produces (ARC-9, #362): the compute devices enumerated on the node, each with its coarse capability (DeviceInfo). This is the JSON boundary the ComputeDevice slice (#359) anticipated for the registry — it feeds the autoscaler / coordinator's capability model. Mirrored by zetta::compute::DeviceRegistry::to_json() / parse_device_report() in include/zetta/compute/device_registry.hpp and enforced by device_info_from_json() in src/core/compute/device_registry.cpp — keep them in sync. A malformed report is rejected at the boundary so a node never silently mis-states its hardware.

devices.description: The compute devices enumerated on the node, in registration order. Empty when the registry holds none.

title: DeviceRegistry capability report
